fact_previews: TalePrints is a project aimed at addressing the decline in imagination among future generations.
TalePrints.com is a new computer program designed to work with schools.
The program aims to encourage children to utilize their imagination and improve their writing and reading skills.
The project addresses the issue of children being distracted by movies, games, and superficial media.
In a classroom scenario, children aged between 11 and 12 years are grouped into six groups of five.

fact_previews: The project involves a classroom of thirty children aged between 11 and 12 years, divided into six groups of five children each.
Each group will choose a leader or have one appointed by a teacher.
The leader's task is to begin a story and ensure that group members adhere to the leader's main vision.
Group members will add to the story while following specific rules and limitations.
At the end of a specified time period, the stories will be completed, edited, and printed.
